Definition: from σθένος (bodily vigor; probably akin to the base of G2476); to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) confirm (in spiritual knowledge and power):--strengthen.
BiblicalUsage: One verse carries the word, and it carries four: the God of all grace, after ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you. Strengthening is the third of the four, and it comes after suffering.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God strengthens after suffering, not instead of it, and the settling is His doing.
